summary.text: Tim Longest is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 34 since 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Tim Longest was born in Greenville, North Carolina.

He graduated from J.H. Rose High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill in 2013, and received a law degree from the University of North Carolina School of Law in 2018.
Longest assumed office on January 1, 2023, succeeding Jack Nichols.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Education - Universities, House Finance, and Marine Resources and Aqua Culture committees, among others.
His 2026 general election opponent is Libertarian Ed George.
